author: 18rajeshkumarg
message:
Fix stale media 404 and heading/landmark semantics on exported pages

- Remove the export's placeholder api/media.php?name=... images, which
  404'd on static GitHub Pages (no PHP endpoint) on 12 pages.
- Demote the extra <h1> section headings to <h2> so each page has a single
  level-1 heading, pinning the original size via indica-h1-size so the
  rendered design is unchanged at every breakpoint.
- Mark the exported navbar div as a navigation landmark (role=navigation).
- Extend fix-pages.mjs with the three steps (idempotent) and document them.

author: 18rajeshkumarg
message:
Support older browsers, Smart TV browsers and JavaScript-less devices

- build an ES5 + polyfilled legacy bundle (optional chaining/nullish
  coalescing and modern built-ins broke older TV and phone engines)
- add a <noscript> fallback so the content is reachable without JS
- add longhand offsets and overflow-x:hidden fallbacks for engines
  that do not understand inset/clip yet
